name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Magnetic Hat Clip
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from durable 1-layer acrylic paired with a sturdy metal magnetic clip, offering a lightweight yet reliable accessory for daily use.
    - The acrylic piece has a 2mm thickness, giving it a clean, polished look while remaining easy to carry.
    - Comes with a metal disc and adhesive dots for secure attachment and stable display.
    - The magnetic clip is designed to hold the personalized acrylic piece firmly while allowing easy removal and reattachment when needed.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Acrylic piece sizes available:
                       +) 1.5 x 1.5 in ~3.81 x 3.81 cm
                       +) 2 x 2 in ~5.08 x 5.08 cm
    - Magnetic clip size: 2.5 x 3 cm ~ 1.0 x 1.18 in
    - Clip thickness: 1 cm ~ 0.39 in
    📌 Note: The product dimensions of the acrylic piece may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Supports single-sided printing to the acrylic piece.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a magnetic hat clip that can be conveniently attached to a hat, visor, pocket, or similar surface.
    - The acrylic piece attaches magnetically, making it easy to remove, reposition, and use whenever needed.
    - Great for adding a personal touch to your golf gear, hat accessories, or custom collectible setup.
    - Compact and lightweight, making it easy to carry without adding bulk.
    - A stylish and functional accessory for everyday use, especially for golf lovers and anyone who enjoys personalized items.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful custom gift for golf players, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Ideal for birthdays, Father’s Day, retirements, tournaments, team events, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Perfect for anyone who wants a personalized golf accessory or a unique keepsake.
    - Great for commemorating names, logos, hobbies, or meaningful themes practically and stylishly.
    - A fun and memorable gift that combines personalization with everyday function.🎁

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Acrylic Magnetic Hat Clip

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
